row.evidence: Pax8 publishes no plan or SCIM information: there is no pricing page (signup only), the public developer docs cover companies, orders and subscriptions with no partner-user or SCIM endpoints, and the help centre is behind a partner login.
row.notes: New row. Pax8 is a cloud marketplace for MSPs; partners sign up and buy vendor licences through it, and no platform subscription price is published (/pricing is 404). Scored as a provisioning target for the MSP's own staff accounts: no SCIM or SSO documentation is public. The help centre (support.pax8.com) requires a Pax8 login and the Trust Center returns a Cloudflare challenge, so status stays unknown. The public REST API (api.pax8.com/v1, OAuth2 client-credentials access token from Integrations > API credentials) manages customer companies, contacts, products, orders, subscriptions, invoices and webhooks; customer 'contacts' are not Pax8 platform users, and no endpoint manages partner staff accounts, so user_api_available is false. Pax8's own provisioning of vendor products (and its Microsoft user-onboarding recipes) is outbound and does not count.

scim.notes: No SCIM documentation for Pax8 partner accounts on pax8.com or devx.pax8.com; the help centre is login-only, so availability is null.

auth.notes: Client credentials from the Integrations Hub exchanged for a bearer access token (audience https://api.pax8.com).

user_api.notes: Partner API covers companies, contacts (customer contacts), products, orders, subscriptions, invoices, usage, quotes and webhooks; no endpoints for Pax8 partner users, roles or permissions in the reference index.

fallbacks.notes: API docs are public, but the help centre (where account/user administration would be documented) requires a Pax8 partner login (c6).
